name: Destiny's Embrace
source:
You step into the shoes of a young and gifted individual with a divine and royal lineage. The story takes place in the enchanting world of Terra, where humans coexist with mythical creatures and powerful deities.

You'll embark on a thrilling journey where destiny (pun intended) intertwines with desire. Since birth you were destined to bring greatness to the Tramonto Empire as its prince, blessed by the seed of the Goddess of Destiny herself. But soon after your birth, the Tramonto Empire and its queen, which is your mother, met its doom against the hands of The Sweet Death, recruited by the demonic Buio Empire.

During the attack, a royal knightess managed to escape from the burning kingdom to bring you to safety. As the knightess was afraid they might've found them, she put you in a basket and trusted it to the winds of a lake. The lake led you to a small village of the Luce Empire, predominantly habitated by elves, where an elven woman named found you. She took care of you and two other girls, an elf named and an amazon around your same age. After you grew up and became an adult, you decided to become an adventurer of a guild named Destiny's Embrace. The story starts from there, the divine prodigy ready to build his own large harem full of hot girls of different species, aiming to become... THE STRONGEST!

[From [URL=https://yqmo.itch.io/destinys-embrace]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
你将扮演一位年轻而有天赋、拥有神圣皇家血统的人。故事发生在迷人的泰拉世界，人类与神话生物和强大的神灵共存。

你将踏上一段激动人心的旅程，命运（双关语）与欲望交织在一起。从出生起，你就注定要作为特拉蒙托帝国的王子，为特拉蒙托帝国带来伟大，并受到命运女神种子的祝福。但在你出生后不久，特拉蒙托帝国和它的女王，也就是你的母亲，就在邪恶的布伊奥帝国招募的甜蜜死亡手中遭遇了毁灭。

在袭击期间，一位皇家女骑士设法逃离燃烧的王国，将你带到安全的地方。由于女骑士担心他们可能会找到它们，因此她将你放入篮子中并将其交给湖风。这条湖把你带到了卢斯帝国的一个小村庄，主要居住着精灵，在那里一位名叫的精灵女人找到了你。她照顾你和另外两个女孩，一个名叫精灵，一个与你年龄相仿的亚马逊人。长大成人后，你决定成为命运之拥公会的冒险者。故事由此开始，神童准备建立自己的大后宫，里面充满了不同种族的辣妹，目标是成为……最强！

[来自 [URL=https://yqmo.itch.io/destinys-embrace]itch.io[/URL]]
